summary: Iteration 2 verification for Scrolic @ptsmiea. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_closed_trades.py (9 pytest cases) covering the NEW GET /api/users/{user_key}/closed-trades pagination+aggregate endpoint, the performance endpoint regression and feed sanity — 9/9 PASS. Frontend: Playwright (390x844 mobile) verified Feed progress-bar changes and the Dashboard summary hero + server-paginated Portfolio tab. Found ONE CRITICAL frontend crash (ReferenceError 'winningTrades is not defined' blanked the entire app on Dashboard) which I fixed as an in-scope undefined-variable reference bug; after that fix all requested dashboard/portfolio assertions pass. Two remaining UI defects reported: missing minus sign on the negative net-profit hero value, and the PWA install banner overlay blocking the portfolio Next button.

ui_bugs.issue: Negative net profit renders WITHOUT a minus sign: shows '$1,117.30' (rose colored) instead of '-$1,117.30'. Code does {netProfitUSD >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${Math.abs(netProfitUSD)} — the negative branch emits an empty prefix. Should be '-'.

Banner overlay intercepts pointer events over the Portfolio pagination footer: normal click on [data-testid=portfolio-next-page] timed out for 30s ('subtree intercepts pointer events' from the install banner and bottom nav). Works only after dismissing the banner or force click. Needs bottom padding for the scroll container / lower z-index / pointer-events fix.

Some rows show a negative profitUSD with a POSITIVE pips value (e.g. 'BTCUSD 1 Lot  $-0.15 / 20.0 Pips' on page 2) — sign mismatch between profit and pips. Likely broker payload/pips-sign derivation, worth confirming.

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: ReferenceError 'winningTrades is not defined' at DashboardView Win/Loss grid card (line ~617) threw a pageerror and unmounted the whole React tree — the entire app rendered a blank black screen with zero data-testids after clicking bottom-nav 'Dashboard'. I replaced the stale reference with the already-computed winsFromServer / lossesFromServer to unblock testing; main agent should review the intended semantics.

issues: Pagination footer sits flush against the fixed bottom nav / install banner (no bottom safe padding) causing the click interception described above

Fix PWA install banner + bottom-nav overlay intercepting clicks on the Portfolio pagination footer (add pb-24 to the scroll container or reduce banner z-index)

critical_code_review_comments: DashboardView.tsx is 960 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; split summary hero / broker hub / portfolio tab into sub-components. A stale variable reference in one branch (winningTrades) took down the entire app, which is exactly the failure mode large monolith views produce.
Conditional hook: useState after an early return in DashboardView (line ~353) — React will throw 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' on the currentUser -> null transition.
Dashboard tab buttons and the summary hero had no data-testid; I added dashboard-tab-portfolio, summary-net-profit, summary-win-rate, summary-win-loss, summary-win-loss-grid.

Backend get_user_closed_trades: page is silently clamped to totalPages (page=99 returns page 10) — acceptable but undocumented; consider returning 404/empty for out-of-range instead of silently changing the requested page.

rca_of_the_issue: Dashboard blank screen RCA: during the portfolioData refactor, the local `winningTrades` array was replaced by server-derived winsFromServer/lossesFromServer, but the Win/Loss grid card (DashboardView.tsx ~line 617) still referenced `winningTrades.length`. Because the identifier no longer existed, React threw an uncaught ReferenceError during render, unmounting the app root (document.body.innerText empty, 0 data-testids). Reproduction: set scrolic_uid cookie, load /, click bottom-nav Dashboard -> black screen + pageerror 'winningTrades is not defined'. Mitigation applied: reference the existing winsFromServer / lossesFromServer values.
